content: Isare bondi goijje
In okkol hoi bade, Isaye hibar sahabi okkolore fũwati loi niyoliyore Kidron zúra farai giye; heṛe ugguwa bagan aššil, hibar butore hiba edde hibar sahabi okkol góille.
Ar Ehudah, ze hibare dorai dil, hitattu o he zagagan zana aššil, kiyollahoile Isaye bout bar hibar sahabi okkolore loi heṛe ekottro oito.
Hetolla Ehudaye ḍõr imam edde Foroši okkolor hentu ek šoinno dol edde hoekzon hitarar hormosari okkolore ainne, ar hitara uzal edde fanoš edde ostro loi heṛe aišše.
Isaye, hibar nizor uwore goṭedde hin okkol zaniyore, hibaye mummikka giye edde hitarare hodde,
Hitara hibare zuwabe hodde, "Nasarator Isare." Isaye hodde,
Ar Ehudah, ze hibare dorai der, hite o hitarar fũwati tiyat aššil.
Isaye zehon hitarare hoiye,
hetunot hitara fissa giye edde meṛit forigiyegoi.
Hibaye hitarare abar fusar goijje,
Hitara hodde,"Nasarator Isare."
Isaye hodde,

content.text: "Ãi to tũwarare hoilam ze, ãi oi. Tũwara zodi ãre tuwor, toile itarare zaito do."

content: Zene hibaye ze hoil hiyan furon o,

content.text: "Tũi zarare ãre diyo, ãi hitarar ekzonore no harai."

content: Simon Fitor, zattu ekkan suri aššil, hibaye hiyan niyolaiye edde ek ḍõr imamor gulamore hamela gori hitar ḍen han haṛi felaiye. (Gulammuwar nam aššilde Malkos.)
Toi Isaye Fitorore hodde,

content.text: "Tor suri ḍafor butore rak; ze fiyala Bafe ãre diye hiba ki ãi no fiyum ne?"

content: Hetunot he šoinno okkole edde hitarar komonḍar edde Ihudi neta okkolor hormosari okkole Isare gereftar goijje edde bainde,
edde foila Isare Annasor heṛe loigiye. Annas aššilde Kaifasor hour, ze he bosoror ḍõr imam aššil.
Ar ei Kaifas, ze Ihudi okkolore mošora dil, ekzon mora iyan mainšolla bala.
Fitoror foila ošikar
Simon Fitor edde ar ekzon sahabi Isar fise fise giye. He dusora sahabiwa ḍõr imamor sina aššil, edde Isar fũwati hite ḍõr imamor góror sarme uṛanot góille,
kintu Fitor bare dorozar hãse tiyai roiye. Toi ḍõr imamor sina dusora sahabiwaye bare giye edde doroza faharadar mayafuware hoiyore Fitorore butore loigiye.
He mayafuwawaye Fitorore hodde, "Tui o ki ei manušwar sahabi okkolor butottu ekzon?" Fitore hodde, "No, ãi no."
Hẽtte beši šit foijjil, hetolla gulam okkol edde faharadar okkole oinor ṭal zaillil edde tiyaiyore oin fuhail. Fitor o hitarar fũwati tiyaiyore oin fuhail.
Ḍõr imam okkolor zera
He šomot ḍõr imame Isattu hibar sahabi okkolor babute edde hibar šikkar babute fusar goijje.
Kintu Isaye zuwabe hodde,

content.text: "Ãi duniyair sarme kulasa gori hota howat asi. Ãi hamiša sinagog okkolot edde dórmogórot, zeṛe Ihudi okkol beggune ekottro o, heṛe šikka diyat asi. Ãi gufone kissu no hoi.
Ãre kiyolla fusar goror? Zara fuinne hitarare fusar goro, ãi hitarare ki hoiyi; so, ãi ki hoiyi hin hitara zane."

content: Isaye ei hota hodde ṭaimot, faharadar okkol butottu ekzon ze hibar ḍake tiyat aššil, hite hibare suwar mariyore hodde, "Endilla neki ḍõr imamore zuwab dodde?"
Isaye hitare hodde,

content.text: "Zodi horaf kissu hoi taki, he horafir goba de, kintu zodi bala hoi taki, toile tui ãre kiyolla maror?"

content: Hetunot Annase banda abostat Isare ḍõr imam Kaifasor hãse defeṛaiye.
Simon Fitor tiyaiyore oin fuhadde šomot, hitara hibare hodde, "Tui o utar sahabi okkolor butottu ekzon no?" Hibaye ošikar goijje edde hodde, "No, ãi no."
Ḍõr imamor gulam okkolor ekzon, Fitore zar han haṛifelail, hitar ek egenaye hodde, "Ãi ki tore baganot hitar fũwati no deki ne?"
Fitore abar ošikar goijje, toi hetunot ugguwa rata kuraye bak diye.
Filator sarme Isa
Bade binna sore hitara Isare Kaifasor hentu Romiyo govarnaror mehelot loigiye. Ar hitara nafak no ofan, edde uddar idor hana hái farefan, hitara nize mehelor butore no gole.
Hetolla Filat baire hitarar ḍake aiyore hodde,"Ei manušwar berudde tũwara kiyor hošuri dodde?"
Hitara hodde, "Ite horaf ham no gorito boli ãra hitare õnor hãse no anitam."
Filate hitarare hodde, "Itare tũwara loizogoi edde tũwara nizor ain mozin bisar gorogoi." Henot hitara hodde, "Kintu honokiyore moron šaza dibar kemota to ãrar hatot nai."
Zene Isar kalam furon o, ziyan hoiyore hibaye dehai dil, hondilla moron hibaye moribo.
Toi Filat abar mehelot góille edde Isare ḍaki hodde, "Tui ki Ihudi okkolor badša?"
Isaye hodde,

content.text: "Tũi ki nize ei hota hor, naki oinno kiye tũware ãr babute iyan hoiye?"

content: Filate zuwabe hodde, "Ãi ki Ihudi? Tor zati edde ḍõr imam okkole tore ãr hatot tuli diye. Tui ki goijjos?"
Isaye zuwabe hodde,

content.text: "Ãr raijjo ei duniyair no; zodi ãr raijjo ei duniyair oito, toile ãre Ihudi neta okkolor hatot tuli diya no ofan, ãr mainše zuddo gorito, kintu ãr raijjo eṛe no."

content: Filate Isare hodde, "Toile ki tui badša?" Isaye hodde,

content.text: "Tũi ṭik hoiyo ze, ãi badša. Soiyir foikka goba dibolla ãi zormo oiyi, ar hetolla ãi duniyait aišši. Fottikiye ze soiyir foikka hite ãr hota fune."

content: Filate hibare hodde, "Soiyi ki?" Ei hota hoi hite abar bare Ihudi neta okkolor hãse zaiyore hodde, "Ãi ei manušwar hono hosuri no fair.
Kintu tũwarar ekkan niyom ase ze, uddar idor ṭaimot ãi tũwarar ekzon hodire tũwaralla eridi. Tũwara ki so ze ãi Ihudi okkolor badšare eridi?"
Hitara beggune abar guzori hodde, "No, hitare no! Ãra Barabbasore sai." He Barabbas aššilde ekzon ḍahait.
